vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_vibe.question: What is vibe coding?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_vibe.answer: Vibe coding is an AI-assisted development approach where developers use AI tools to generate, modify, explore and debug code through natural-language instructions and quick iteration, with the developer reviewing and directing the work.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_ai_r.question: Is AI replacing developers?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_ai_r.answer: No. AI tools speed up parts of implementation, but architecture, security, data modelling, testing and the judgement about whether the result is correct still require a developer.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_buil.question: Can you build complete websites using AI-assisted development?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_buil.answer: Yes, complete websites and applications can be delivered this way, but the code is reviewed, tested and adjusted by developers before release rather than shipped straight from a tool.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_tech.question: What technologies can be used?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_tech.answer: The same technologies we use in conventional projects: React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS on the frontend, Node.js, Python or Java on the backend, and databases with JSON for data and integrations.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_aige.question: Is AI-generated code reviewed and tested?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_aige.answer: Yes. Every change is read by a developer and tested functionally and across devices before deployment, because AI tools can produce code that looks correct but behaves incorrectly.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_aias.question: Is AI-assisted development cheaper?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_aias.answer: It can reduce the time spent on repetitive implementation, which affects cost on some projects. It does not remove the time needed for planning, review, testing and maintenance.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_will.question: Will the code be maintainable by other developers?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_will.answer: That is the intention. We keep to standard frameworks and conventional project structure, and we document the setup, so the codebase does not depend on any particular tool.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_use_.question: Do you use AI on every project?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_use_.answer: No. It is applied where it helps, mainly prototyping, UI implementation and routine work. Sensitive or complex logic is written and reviewed carefully by hand.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_aias.question: Is AI-assisted code secure?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_aias.answer: No code is secure simply because of how it was written. We review authentication, input validation, permissions and credential handling as a separate step, regardless of whether AI tools were involved.

vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_impr.question: Can you improve an existing project using this approach?
vibe_coding_ai_assisted_development_impr.answer: Yes. AI-assisted workflows are often useful for refactoring, debugging and adding features to an existing codebase, provided a developer understands the code before changing it.
